goal:
PoE1 3.30 Covens of Umbra, softcore trade. Make multiple mirrors through farming, crafting and investing.
Wanted: 5 for mapping AND 5 for bossing.
What the 3.30 patch changed for build choice: item rarity now decides drop pools, so killing rares, uniques and Fate-empowered bosses pays more than raw pack clear. Winter Orb was nerfed hard (2 projectiles, 70% effectiveness, about 15% less base damage). Golems and mercenaries were nerfed. Pathfinder, Trickster and Warden were buffed. Energy Shield uniques got buffs.

builds.name: Winter Orb Occultist
builds.notes: Most played Winter Orb version in Allflame (4.5%, #2 overall). Starts cheap (Tuadh's Exarch & Eater league start run was ~3 div) and scales very high: a 3.30 PoB shows ~117M DPS with 162k EHP on ~120 div. The 5/5 scores are for the invested version (roughly 50-120 div); expect about 4/4 in the first days.
builds.patch: NERFED in 3.30: Winter Orb now fires 2 projectiles at every level (was 2-3), 70% added damage effectiveness (was 80%), 307-460 base cold at level 20 (was 360-539). Still a cheap starter, but no longer 5/5.

builds.name: Toxic Rain Pathfinder
builds.notes: Called 'The Fastest League Start Build in Allflame League'. Very forgiving on day 1, flasks keep it safe.
builds.patch: Pathfinder was buffed in 3.30 (Master Alchemist removes all ailments on flask use; Master Distiller gives 30% penetration and +100% crit multi). Safe starter, but bossing still trails the DoT and brand picks.

builds.name: Lightning Arrow Deadeye
builds.notes: Fubgun's go-to league starter. Fastest clear for farming strategies; weak bosser until geared. Mirror-tier gear makes it absurd.
builds.patch: Pathfinder/Deadeye bows unchanged. Best pure clear, but the new rarity rules reward killing strong monsters more than fast clear. Bossing is its weak point.

builds.name: Winter Orb Elementalist
builds.notes: Fubgun's Allflame starter (most viewed guide). Winter Orb Occultist and Elementalist were the #2 and #3 builds on poe.ninja at league end.
builds.patch: NERFED in 3.30 (same Winter Orb nerf). Elementalist golem nodes were also weakened by the golem nerf.

builds.name: Kinetic Blast of Clustering Necromancer
builds.notes: Fast wand clear. Its 21/20 gem sold for 387c on day 3 last league, so its gems are worth levelling if it is popular again.
builds.patch: Unchanged, but weak bossing matters more now that strong monsters drop the valuable currency.

builds.name: Cold DoT Occultist
builds.tags: 5/5 mapping + bossing, DoT, energy shield, untouched by 3.30 nerfs
builds.notes: bLut posted a 3.30 '100 Div Endgame' version (Creeping Frost + Vortex) two days ago. One-button mapper that scales into strong bossing, fast campaign. Post-patch tier lists rate it 5 league start, 5 endgame, 5 mapping. Endgame path: keep this as the farmer and reroll Penance Brand Elementalist as the mirror-tier bosser. Backup plan: swapped out for the Ice Shot Warden on launch day.
builds.patch: PICK for 3.30. Not touched by any nerf (only Winter Orb and golems were hit in the Witch tree). DoT ticks while you dodge Fate mechanics, and bossing reaches 5 with investment (tier lists give 4 on a budget).

builds.name: Righteous Fire Chieftain
builds.notes: Most played build in Allflame at league end (4.6%). Very tanky for heavily juiced maps; needs life and regen gear first.
builds.patch: Unchanged. Survives anything but kills Fate bosses slowly; tier lists give it 2/5 for Fate bossing.

builds.name: Shockwave Cyclone Slayer
builds.notes: Melee map blaster. Cyclone of Tumult and Void Shockwave Slayers were both top 10 at league end.
builds.patch: Unchanged. Cyclone of Tumult Slayer rated 4 for bossing and 5 for mapping on post-patch lists.

builds.name: Animate Guardian Luminary
builds.notes: Top 4 in Allflame. Luminary was introduced with Allflame; check if it stays in 3.30.
builds.patch: Luminary still exists in 3.30, but mercenaries were nerfed hard (-60% resistances in maps, less damage). Avoid.

builds.name: Penance Brand Elementalist
builds.tags: 5/5 mapping + bossing, brands, mirror-tier endgame pick
builds.notes: Best place to sink mirror-level currency in 3.30. Joker Khrono's 3.29 Penance Brand of Dissipation version showed about 48M DPS and was billed as clearing uber bosses almost instantly. It scales cleanly with gear: every big upgrade (gem levels, crit, spell damage, a mirror-tier weapon) adds damage without breaking defences, and brands keep hitting while you dodge. Plan: start Cold DoT Occultist, farm and invest week 1, then build this as the endgame bosser once you have roughly 150+ div.
builds.patch: Mostly unchanged, but check whether the guide relies on golems with Liege of the Primordial: golem buffs were cut about 20-25% in 3.30.

builds.name: Bifurcating Crit Blade Vortex Assassin
builds.notes: Rated 5 endgame, 5 Fate bossing, 5 mapping, but only 3 for league start: needs gear before it shines.
builds.patch: Unchanged in 3.30. Best as a second character once the Cold DoT Occultist is farming.

builds.name: Earthshatter Berserker
builds.notes: Tier lists call it the safest 3.30 starter; racers took it to level 99 in SSF by day three last league.
builds.patch: Unchanged. Great all-rounder, but 4/4 rather than 5/5.

builds.name: Explosive Arrow Ballista Hierophant
builds.notes: The most watched 3.30 league start plan so far (POEGuy, about 60k views).
builds.patch: New Artillery Quiver implicit (+1 maximum totems for attack skills) helps ballista builds.

builds.name: Shrine Stacker Hierophant
builds.tags: highest ceiling, Mageblood required, not a starter
builds.notes: Highest number on any 3.29 PoB (about 384M DPS) but locked behind Mageblood, Bottled Faith, The Gull, Blunderbore and Nimis. A flex build once you already have mirrors, not a way to make them.
builds.patch: Check 3.30 notes for any change to shrine buffs before buying in. Gear-gated, so it only makes sense after the first few mirrors.

builds.name: Ice Shot of Penetration Warden
builds.tags: bow, cold convert, Ephemeral Bolts tech, Warden buffed
builds.notes: Starter PoB (pobb.in/UZcCoQJdB7YD): about 33.7M DPS on roughly 7 div, but only 3.5k life, 20k EHP and a 7.2k max physical hit (100% suppression, 73% evade). Levels with Galvanic Arrow, then Ice Shot; early maps on Elemental Hit, then swap to Ice Shot of Penetration. Needs Ahuana's Bite, Fury Valve, Heatshiver and a 500+ pdps bow. With Reclaimed Malevolence giving Ephemeral Bolts, every split shard hits the same target at close range, which tier lists put at 20 to 60 times the single target damage. Bossing would jump to 5 and pass Cold DoT, but you have to stand within about 5 m of the boss on a squishy character.
builds.patch: Warden was buffed in 3.30 and bows went to S tier because of the Ephemeral Bolts interaction. The jewel tech can still be hotfixed (open bug report about Return ignoring the 5 m cap).

targets.title: Gear up the Ice Shot Warden
targets.why: SnooBAE85's PoB, in buying order. P1 is buy-first, P3 can wait. Uniques show the cheapest normal listing on the selected league; the rest are crafts or rares you buy by mods. Levels as Deadeye with Galvanic Arrow, then Elemental Hit of the Spectrum in early maps, then Ice Shot of Penetration once the swap items are in.

steps.t: Elemental Hit of the Spectrum gem, buy it around Act 6 when you reach Master Fletcher and Multishot
Prismweave belt: flat elemental damage for every hit
Wake of Destruction boots: movement speed and flat lightning
Quill Rain bow: his best leveling bow until high red maps
Movement speed Quicksilver flask, then Jade and a bleed-removal life flask
Fury Valve amulet: stays all the way to endgame, buy this first
Heatshiver helmet: also stays to endgame
Ahuana's Bite quiver: needed for the Ice Shot swap
Painseeker gloves until your rare gloves are crafted
Endless Diamond Flask plus a Lynx Quicksilver (accuracy, crit)
Cap elemental resists and spell suppression, reach 85, swap Deadeye to Warden at the 4th lab
Ice Shot of Penetration gem, plus quality on the main link and Sniper's Mark
steps.phase: 3. Swap to Ice Shot of Penetration

steps.t: Bow: high flat cold and lightning, attack speed, bench craft Str/Int + crit (his notes say a 500 pdps bow is enough to start the swap)
Eldritch gloves: Exarch rage on hit, Eater suppression, life, resists, attack speed
Eldritch boots: Exarch action speed, Eater travel skill cooldown, life, resists, movement speed
Hyrri's Ire body armour
Death Rush ring
Winterweave ring
Maligaro's Restraint belt (replaces Prismweave)
The Writhing Jar flask
Doedre's Elixir flask
Lioneye's Fall jewel: turns melee nodes near it into bow nodes
The Light of Meaning, Life variant
Rare quiver: life, bow crit multiplier, attack speed, flat lightning (replaces Ahuana's Bite)
Rare ring for the third slot: life, chaos resistance, all resists, Intelligence
Rare jewel: crit multiplier with elemental skills, 6% life, reduced shock
Then chase Reclaimed Malevolence (Ephemeral Bolts), see the goal above

targets.title: Get Ephemeral Bolts for Ice Shot
targets.why: Reclaimed Malevolence swaps one Ascendancy notable for an Abyss notable picked by the jewel's seed and your class. The Ephemeral Bolts roll turns Ice Shot of Penetration into a shotgun: every split shard hits the boss. It does nothing for Cold DoT, so this goal only matters if you play the Ice Shot Warden.

steps.t: Level the Ice Shot Warden into maps on SnooBAE85's PoB
Day 1: confirm Abyssal Depths still open from Abyss pits in level 78+ maps
After the first hotfixes: confirm Ephemeral Bolts plus Ice Shot still works
Save up to the budget and watch the live price above (track it in Portfolio)

Pick a route: buy the cheapest uncorrupted copy, or craft it if the four Historic jewels cost less. On a Warden, seeds that land on Oath of Winter or Mother's Teachings are the safest if you don't want to reroll
Craft route: kill Ulaman (Eye of Malevolence) and Amanamu (Eye of Authority) in Abyssal Depths
Craft route: make Zorath's Eye and open the Lightless Hollow
Craft route: combine Baleful Dominion, Destructive Aspiration, Festering Vengeance and Extinguishing Grasp
Socket it on the Warden and open the Ascendancy panel: hover the notable that changed and read its new name
Not Ephemeral Bolts? Take it out, use a Divine Orb on it (rerolls the seed), socket it and check again
Keep rolling until it says Ephemeral Bolts AND the notable it took is not Enduring Suffusion or Seasoned Hunter (the PoB uses both)
Allocate the new notable, fix the tree around the conquered path and test on a pinnacle boss
